en: Oh! Oh my! Is that a Heracross with you?
I simply must know how big it is. May I measure it? Please?
{size}! A horn to horn length of {size}!
That is the finest Heracross I have ever been shown.
Here, you must take this. A splendid Pokémon deserves a splendid ball.
I shall write it on my chart at once. Do come back if you find a bigger one!
Heracross are the most marvellous Pokémon! The bigger the horn, the better.
Bring one to my door and I'll measure it for you, on my word.
The very same, to the millimetre! How uncanny.
This one comes to {size}. A fine Heracross, truly.
But the chart says {record}, and the chart does not lie.
This won't do at all. I measure Heracross and nothing else!
No? Oh, how disappointing. I had my tape ready and all.
A chart for writing down Heracross sizes. The biggest so far: {record}.
A chart for writing down Heracross sizes. Nothing is written on it yet.
